nodes.name: Browser gateway
nodes.responsibility: The one door a browser has into the workbench: snapshots out, admitted commands in, one lease per tab session, and every pane of a tab is carried out by the workhorse of the checkout the tab shows

nodes.name: Codex session
nodes.responsibility: One initialized session and the reviewed methods it will send

nodes.name: Workhorse queue
nodes.responsibility: Codex's queue of messages waiting for the workhorse: list, add, edit, reorder, delete, or start one now

nodes.name: Voice coordinator
nodes.responsibility: The separate fast thread each tab session's voice attaches to, started with the tab's first message or Talk: the voice model's subconscious, which routes sustained work to a named checkout's workhorse

nodes.name: Codex app-server
nodes.responsibility: The Codex binary, run as one private child over stdio in the Archboard-only Codex home

nodes.name: Browser pane
nodes.responsibility: The pane a user works in: it names its tab session, holds the tab's lease, sends commands and draws the published state

nodes.name: Workhorse operations
nodes.responsibility: The four things the coordinator may ask of the workhorse of a checkout it names, one at a time: delegate, steer, inspect, manage its queue; each workhorse has its own

nodes.name: Tab sessions
nodes.responsibility: What each browser tab owns: its coordinator and voice, and one workhorse for each checkout it works in, found by the thread a notification or tool call names

nodes.name: Conversation start
nodes.responsibility: Starts a conversation on a pane's first message or Talk: the tab's coordinator ready first, then the workhorse of the shown checkout, then board news to it

nodes.name: Session workhorses
nodes.responsibility: One workhorse for each checkout of a tab session: its starter, board news, queue, operations and link actions, built on first use

nodes.name: Coordinator turn homes
nodes.responsibility: Remembers, for each coordinator turn, the conversation shown when it started and the checkouts it gave work to, so the dock shows the turn in the right conversation

nodes.name: Per-tab sessions
nodes.responsibility: Gives each browser tab its own session: finds the session a call names, knows which tab each pane belongs to, ends a tab no pane returns to, and remembers where each coordinator turn is shown

nodes.name: Pane conversations
nodes.responsibility: What a pane sees and says: the gateway with its lease, snapshots and commands, the start of a conversation, the dock's list of workhorses, and the approvals raised to the person

nodes.name: Workhorses
nodes.responsibility: The sustained work of each checkout: a workhorse's thread link, queue, operations, start and board news, built per tab session on first use, with its tool calls and the context of what changed
